questions.question: Explain the formation of a waterfall and gorge using geological structure

points.text: River flows over hard rock (cap rock) onto soft rock below. Soft rock erodes faster (hydraulic action, abrasion) creating plunge pool and undercutting. Hard rock collapses -> waterfall retreats upstream -> steep-sided gorge left behind. Cap rock provides resistant layer
